Reviewed correctness/security boundaries
- All 61 registration call sites flow through the same profile check and framedHandler. Unknown tools and unknown profiles fail closed; default read registration excludes the eight catalog write tools. Existing user-configured monitoring is distinct from callable tools and is transparently documented.
- Handler success paths consistently return raw data into the shared wrapper, preserving text/structuredContent agreement. Sanitization strips documented invisible classes from values and keys, retains visible prose, preserves own __proto__ fields, handles key collisions, cuts cycles and bounds depth/object visits. Errors from handlers carry the sanitized bounded error notice. The implementation and documentation do not claim serialized-byte limits or runtime prompt-injection immunity.
- The help trust exemption now admits own catalog/index identifiers and ASCII slugs before reads; canonical package-root, lstat, realpath, containment and direct-parent checks reject docs/category/file redirects and nonregular resources. Legitimate ancestor installation symlinks work; missing/malformed resources retain fallback/warnings. Reflected request values still receive shared sanitization. The stated intact-package assumption excludes hostile local replacement races.
- Sidecar commands forcibly carry external origin and cap target fields. Renderer validation rejects malformed/nonfinite cursors before advancing lastSeenAt. All feedback/dismissals queue irrespective of claimed origin; signatures derive locally from the matched hypothesis and are captured once. Confirm consumes an unexpired suggestion once and records the captured vote/dismissal signature; Discard does not apply it. Dismissal TTL starts at confirmation. Skeptic behavior remains immediate. Store cap, expiry, persistence validation, and deduplication are consistent with the contract. HUD delegates actions and renders statement/note text with textContent.
- Installer uses genuine npm pack and locked project ci with scripts disabled, unchanged manifest/lock verification, safe archive admission, executable-bin checks, exact installed graph and override checks, and package-scoped promotion with alias collision checks and graceful rollback. The change avoids override-blind global dependency resolution. It preserves other packages/aliases; staged recovery on rollback failure and lack of crash-atomic multi-directory publication are documented limitations.
- Fixed trusted-selector entries retain the original inner suites and add finite orchestration. Shared runner rejects launch/status/signal/timeout/abort/overflow/cleanup/bailout and incomplete or unhealthy final TAP summaries. Stage output is finite; ownership is tied to detached POSIX process groups. Existing routing remains additive. No baseline selector, CI policy, assertions or validation gate were weakened.
- Fixture environments strip inherited provider/config/executable controls, use fake paths and explicit guard propagation, and admit only exact locked SHA512 tarball bodies into empty private caches. Guard claims are limited to exercised JS HTTP/fetch paths, not a universal OS sandbox. Genuine installed smoke remains distinct from synthetic result-validation tests.
